elements.name: Trade Identifier
elements.definition: The system-of-record identifier assigned to a trade at execution.

elements.name: Parent Trade Identifier
elements.definition: The identifier of the originating trade from which this trade was derived (e.g. allocation, novation).

elements.name: Trade Reference
elements.definition: A free-form or external reference associated with the trade.

elements.name: Trade Status
elements.definition: The current processing or lifecycle state of the trade.

elements.name: Trade Version Number
elements.definition: The sequential version of the trade record, incremented on amendment.

elements.name: Trade Event Type
elements.definition: The lifecycle event that produced this record \u2014 new, amend, cancel, novation.

elements.name: Current Record Indicator
elements.definition: Flag identifying the current/latest version of a trade among its versions.

elements.name: Notional Amount
elements.definition: The nominal or face value of a derivative used to calculate contractual payments; not itself exchanged.

elements.name: Coupon Rate
elements.definition: The stated annual interest rate paid on a fixed-income security.

elements.name: Yield
elements.definition: The effective rate of return on a fixed-income security given its price.

elements.name: Accrued Interest
elements.definition: Interest earned on a fixed-income position since the last coupon payment date but not yet paid.

elements.name: Principal Amount
elements.definition: The principal cash amount of a fixed-income trade.

elements.name: Trade Price
elements.definition: The execution price of the trade, expressed per the instrument's convention.

elements.name: Trade Quantity
elements.definition: The traded quantity, volume, or number of contracts.

elements.name: Commodity Option Premium
elements.definition: The premium paid or received on a commodity option.

elements.name: Instrument Identifier
elements.definition: A standard market identifier for the traded security (CUSIP, ISIN, ticker).

elements.name: Instrument Type
elements.definition: The classification of the instrument's structural form.

elements.name: Option Exercise Type
elements.definition: Whether the option is a put or a call.

elements.name: Product Type
elements.definition: The product classification carried on the trade as sourced from the SOR (e.g. TREAS, CommoditySwap).

elements.name: Product Sub-Type
elements.definition: The finer product classification beneath product type (e.g. TBOND, EFP).

elements.name: Product Family
elements.definition: The top-level product grouping (e.g. Commodity, Fixed Income).

elements.name: Net Present Value
elements.definition: The present value of a trade's expected future cash flows in USD.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Profit and Loss Explained
elements.definition: The decomposition of P&L change attributed to identifiable market and trade factors.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Realised Profit and Loss
elements.definition: P&L locked in from closed or settled positions.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Unrealised Profit and Loss
elements.definition: Mark-to-market P&L on open positions not yet settled.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Closing Price
elements.definition: The official closing or mark price used for valuation.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Option Delta
elements.definition: The sensitivity of a position's value to a unit change in the underlying price.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Gamma
elements.definition: The rate of change of delta with respect to the underlying price.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Vega
elements.definition: The sensitivity of value to a change in implied volatility.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Theta
elements.definition: The sensitivity of value to the passage of time (time decay).
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Rho
elements.definition: The sensitivity of value to a change in interest rates.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Higher-Order Sensitivity
elements.definition: Higher-order risk sensitivities such as skew, speed, and cross-correlation effects.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Counterparty Credit Spread Sensitivity
elements.definition: The sensitivity of value to a one-basis-point move in the counterparty's credit spread (CS01).
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Own Credit Spread Sensitivity
elements.definition: The sensitivity of value to a one-basis-point move in Wells Fargo's own credit spread.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Recovery Rate
elements.definition: The assumed recovery rate on default for counterparty or own credit.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Credit Valuation Adjustment
elements.definition: The adjustment to derivative value reflecting counterparty credit risk.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Initial Margin
elements.definition: Margin posted to cover potential future exposure on a trade.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Collateral Agreement Reference
elements.definition: Reference to the CSA or collateral agreement governing margining.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Traded Position
elements.definition: The position quantity on a traded basis as of the business date.

elements.name: Settled Position
elements.definition: The position quantity on a settled basis as of the business date.

elements.name: Position Cost
elements.definition: The cost basis of a held position.

elements.name: Position Identifier
elements.definition: The identifier of a position or inventory holding.

elements.name: Inventory Name
elements.definition: The name of the inventory book holding the position.

elements.name: Counterparty Identifier
elements.definition: The identifier of the counterparty that participates in a financial transaction.

elements.name: Customer Identifier
elements.definition: The identifier of the customer associated with the trade.

elements.name: Customer Name
elements.definition: The name of the customer associated with the trade.

elements.name: Legal Entity
elements.definition: The legal entity of Wells Fargo or the counterparty booking the trade.

elements.name: Desk
elements.definition: The trading desk that owns the trade or position.

elements.name: Portfolio
elements.definition: The portfolio or book to which the trade is assigned.

elements.name: Business Unit
elements.definition: The organisational business unit responsible for the trade.

elements.name: Trader
elements.definition: The trader who executed or owns the trade.

elements.name: Region
elements.definition: The geographic region of the book or desk.

elements.name: Sales Credit Amount
elements.definition: The sales credit attributed to a trade for revenue allocation.

elements.name: Sales Markup
elements.definition: The markup applied on a trade contributing to sales revenue.

elements.name: Marketing Fee
elements.definition: The marketing fee or marketer compensation associated with the trade.

elements.name: Commission
elements.definition: Commission charged or paid on the trade.

elements.name: Settlement Currency
elements.definition: The currency in which the trade settles.

elements.name: Clearing Broker
elements.definition: The broker through which the trade is cleared.

elements.name: Executing Broker
elements.definition: The broker through which the trade was executed.

elements.name: Clearing Account
elements.definition: The GMI or clearing account identifier.

elements.name: TRACE Control Number
elements.definition: The FINRA TRACE control number assigned on regulatory trade reporting.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: MSRB Code
elements.definition: The MSRB classification applied for municipal securities reporting.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Regulatory Trade Identifier
elements.definition: Identifiers assigned by regulatory or venue reporting systems (WINFITS, venue, MIC).
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Hedge Indicator
elements.definition: Flags identifying bona-fide hedge or DSOM status for regulatory purposes.
elements.subDomain: Business Management and Frontline Risk Management Data

elements.name: Trade Date
elements.definition: The date on which the trade was executed.

elements.name: Settlement Date
elements.definition: The date on which the trade settles.

elements.name: Maturity Date
elements.definition: The date on which the instrument matures or expires.

elements.name: Business Date
elements.definition: The processing business date of the record.

elements.name: Execution Timestamp
elements.definition: The precise time the trade was executed or booked.

elements.name: Source File Name
elements.definition: The name of the source file from which the record was ingested by 1MBDA.

elements.name: Source System Identifier
elements.definition: The identifier of the originating source system (SOR).

elements.name: Source Dataset Identifier
elements.definition: The identifier of the source dataset within the SOR.

elements.name: Ingestion Timestamp
elements.definition: The time at which 1MBDA ingested the record.

elements.name: Record Hash
elements.definition: Hash values used for change detection and record integrity.
